answer: Entry is sold by all-pay auction, and every bidder pays, so even losing bids cost money. A farm needs 345 separate bids, since each bid is paid whether it wins or loses. The lantern test is the price tag: 345 fakes mean 345 payments. The auction is recorded on-chain, and the total paid is public. The ember signal is visible to every grader, and the ridge ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
